name: pi-desktop
description: Pi coding agent desktop app. Independent of the pi-main source tree.
author: Pi

scripts.pack: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:win: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:win:sign: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=true
scripts.pack:mac: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:mac:x64: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.pack:mac:arm64: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.pack:all: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --win --mac
scripts.pack:dir: npm run version:bump && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
